messages:
Oliver (Vendor): Hi team - sending invoice OLV-3342 for April. PDF attached but merged two POs (8122 & 8123). Link: https://vendorfiles.example/OLV-3342 :paperclip:
Priya (Finance Ops): Thanks Oliver. Our auto PO-match only sees PO 8122 on header. Need explicit PO references or split files to route approvals.
Oliver (Vendor): Sorry about the merge. We can split into two invoices and resend by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (AP): If split comes tomorrow that's fine, but manual review will otherwise delay payment 5-7 business days. Any chance you can sign a short vendor ack to accept TEMP PO for the missing PO?
Nora (Procurement): We can provision TEMP-7410 for PO 8123 to avoid hold, but vendor must sign acknowledgement and confirm amounts per PO.
Oliver (Vendor): We can sign the ack. Please send the template and TEMP PO number and we'll return signed PDF within a few hours.
Priya (Finance Ops): Ack template: https://redwood.internal/ap/vendor-ack. Please name reissued files OLV-3342_8122.pdf and OLV-3342_8123.pdf to help OCR.
Invoice-bot: Invoice OLV-3342 attached for VendorCo - total $18,750 - status: pending_manual_review.
Sam (AP): I'll add hold note: "OLV-3342 awaiting split or TEMP-7410" and set 72h follow-up in AP queue. Ping here when signed ack is uploaded.
Oliver (Vendor): Signed ack incoming in 1-2 hours. We'll resend split invoices tomorrow morning. Thanks for the fast turnaround.
Priya (Finance Ops): Great, action items: 1) @Nora create TEMP-7410, 2) @Oliver upload signed ack, 3) @Sam hold and monitor. Thanks all :thumbsup:
